title: Job Offer Scam
description: Practice handling a caller who claims you have been selected for a remote position and demands upfront payment to secure the job.
saferResponse: I’ll verify the position through the company’s official careers page.

agentVariables.caller_identity: a fictional recruiter for a remote job opportunity
agentVariables.fictional_problem: an apparently urgent hiring decision that requires upfront payment for equipment
agentVariables.requested_action: pay for equipment immediately to secure the fictional position
